description: The one deprecated expression-node `op` alias: `aggregate`, the pre-1.1.0 spelling of `faq` (Functional Aggregate Query). Pins the four properties every binding must share.

cases.assert: emits exactly one `deprecated_op_alias` warning for the document, naming the node count (2), NOT one per node
emit(load(aliased)) is byte-identical to canonical.esm — the alias never survives the loader
loads with NO `deprecated_op_alias` warning, and emit(load(x)) == x (the §9.6.4 fixed point holds at the current version)
REJECTED — `arrayop` was removed at esm 0.8.0 and is not an alias
loads; the child's alias is normalized to `faq` too, and `emit` carries no `aggregate` — the wire boundary covers REFERENCED documents, not just the root
REJECTED with `removed_op` — the child's removed spelling is caught at the child's own wire boundary

REJECTED with `faq_version_too_old`; the gate reads the AUTHORED form, so a pre-1.1.0 document carrying the legal `aggregate` alias is NOT caught and is instead normalized with its version raised to the 1.1.0 floor

note: Some bindings resolve subsystem `{ref}`s during load; TypeScript exposes it as a separate `resolveSubsystemRefs` API. A binding's adapter invokes whatever its load path requires — the CONTRACT is that once refs are resolved, no deprecated alias and no removed op survives anywhere in the document.
